governing_intent: Provide a fail-closed, read-only doctor gate that refuses autonomous work unless the configured profile has positively evidenced configuration, integration, persistence, and execution readiness.
summary: PY-09 is one bounded pre-autonomy validation capability. It specifies required checks, fail-closed outcomes, exit codes, sanitization, non-mutation, CLI/run integration, and executable proof without requiring a new product or architecture decision.
implementation_unknowns: Define a uniform adapter-error classifier that distinguishes FAIL, UNAVAILABLE, and unknown while preserving sanitized causes.
Design the check-provider interfaces and recorded fixture/local-double arrangements for predecessor capabilities.
Select safe non-mutating evidence for publication and execution capability.
Exercise the reserved WARNING aggregation path using a test-only result fixture, since Wave 1 defines no advisory checks.
verification_assessment: Strong and mechanically verifiable: real CLI subprocess execution with retained exit statuses; pass/fail coverage for every check; specified negative evidence cases; real run-refusal proof for FAIL and UNAVAILABLE; stable JSON; sentinel-secret leakage testing; non-mutation assertions; and fitness and Node-suite preservation. Recorded fixtures and local doubles are appropriate here; PY-10 owns real-target proof.
material_risks: The doctor spans several predecessor adapters, so outcome classification and sanitization must remain consistent.
A capability probe must remain non-mutating and avoid creating unowned external resources.
The verification harness must be established before broad repair work, with discriminating proof for changed paths.
next_action: Advance PY-09 through the authorized workflow once PY-05, PY-06, and PY-08 are accepted; implementation can proceed under the stated contract without new owner decisions.
rationale: SF-REQ-038 directly requires validation of installation, Work Management, provider, source-control, transport, lifecycle mapping, persistence, and execution capability before autonomous work. PY-09 covers each required extent, fixes fail-closed semantics through SWF-13, preserves the established ownership boundary, explicitly excludes installer and broader product work, and leaves only normal engineering and test-design choices to implementation.
